understanding: After WB_RST_I deassertion on fixed symbolic clock, verify Divisor Latch reads zero via DLAB-gated reads and DUT outputs leave X/Z to known state, after bring-up reset order.
preconditions: Bring-up reset order from t_bringup_clk available: assert then deassert via reset with symbolic active level on fixed symbolic clock period
Clock is running; WAIT durations are symbolic clock cycles with no DUT timing claim
wishbone_bus owns wb_adr_i wb_dat_i wb_we_i wb_stb_i wb_cyc_i wb_sel_i and serial_data owns srx_pad_i and modem_control_if owns cts_pad_i dsr_pad_i ri_pad_i dcd_pad_i
Divisor not yet programmed; divisor access requires DLAB=1 per documented gating
stimulus_steps: ASSERT reset to SYM_RESET_ACTIVE and WAIT SYM_RESET_CYCLES clock cycles [f_reset_port]
DEASSERT reset then WAIT SYM_IDLE_CYCLES clock cycles on clock for post-reset settle
DRIVE idle via wishbone_bus and via serial_data on srx_pad_i and via modem_control_if on cts_pad_i dsr_pad_i ri_pad_i dcd_pad_i with no traffic
WRITE LCR DLAB to 1 via wishbone_bus to enable divisor access [f_dlab_gate]
READ address 0 via wishbone_bus to SAMPLE DIV_LSB and READ address 1 via wishbone_bus to SAMPLE DIV_MSB [f_lsb_map f_msb_map]
WRITE LCR DLAB to 0 via wishbone_bus to restore normal register map [f_dlab_gate]
check_steps: SAMPLE wb_dat_o wb_ack_o stx_pad_o int_o rts_pad_o dtr_pad_o after WAIT SYM_IDLE_CYCLES and COMPARE each is-not X and is-not Z; FAIL on any X/Z [f_known_outputs f_reset_port]
COMPARE DIV_LSB == 0x00 and DIV_MSB == 0x00 and combined 16-bit divisor == 0x0000; REPORT non-zero as reset-value failure [f_div_zero f_lsb_map f_msb_map]
IF any output SAMPLE is X/Z or any divisor byte is non-zero THEN STOP and REPORT known-after-reset failure with no further traffic
completion: WAIT for both divisor reads and all output known-state samples to complete
ENFORCE TEST_TIMEOUT_CYCLES as testbench operational limit only, not DUT timing requirement
CLEANUP restore LCR DLAB to 0 and return wishbone_bus serial_data modem_control_if to idle

facts.statement: Divisor Latch register is set to 0 upon reset before programming
facts.quote: • The Divisor Latch register is set to 0.

facts.statement: Divisor LSB is 8-bit RW at bus address 0
facts.quote: Divisor Latch Byte 1 (LSB) 0 8 RW The LSB of the divisor

facts.statement: Divisor MSB is 8-bit RW at bus address 1
facts.quote: Divisor Latch Byte 2 1 8 RW The MSB of the divisor

facts.statement: Divisor bytes accessible only when LCR bit 7 DLAB is 1 when normal registers at 0-1 not accessible
facts.quote: The registers can be accessed when the 7th (DLAB) bit of the Line Control Register is set

facts.statement: DUT outputs must reach known non-X/Z values after WB_RST_I deassertion
